content: Anthropic 'Building Effective Agents': most successful implementations use simple composable patterns (prompt chaining, routing, parallelization, orchestrator-worker, evaluator-optimizer) not frameworks; start with direct API calls; multi-agent uses 10-15x tokens so do the math before committing; add complexity only when it demonstrably improves results; understand framework internals if used; start with single-purpose agents that do one thing well.
